seo.title: Styling Guidelines
seo.description: CSS and Tailwind styling rules: allowed utility prefixes, forbidden colors, required cn utility usage

header.title: Styling and CSS System Guidelines
header.description: Centralized UI management through design tokens (CSS Variables) and Tailwind CSS configuration.

benefit_text: Leveraging a single source of truth via <one>CSS Variables</one> allows for instant theme changes and ensures all components follow defined design tokens.

styles.label: Global Styles
styles.text: The <one>globals.css</one> file imports Tailwind v4, variables.css and theme.css, and defines base layers.

config.label: Configuration (Tailwind v4)
config.text: Configured in CSS: <one>@theme inline</one> in theme.css maps CSS variables to utilities, @custom-variant enables the dark class. No tailwind.config.ts.

variables.title: CSS Variables
variables.description: Technical tokens in @theme: breakpoints and font sizes become utilities directly.

theme.title: Theming
theme.description: All color tokens for light and dark modes, mapped to utilities via @theme inline.

global.title: Global Layers
global.description: Tailwind initialization and base element styles.

restrictions.title: Forbidden Palettes
restrictions.description: Absolute restriction on standard Tailwind colors (blue-500, red-600, etc.) and static white/black. All colors must be derived from design tokens.
